Research and impact
Top in Scotland for engineering research excellence (REF 2021)
96% of our research was judged 'world-leading' or 'internationally excellent' (REF 2021)
At Glasgow, our world-leading facilities, renowned researchers, and vibrant postgraduate research community drive innovation with purpose. Explore our principal research themes addressing global challenges, our societal impact, and the specialist centres, facilities, and divisions that support them.
Research
Research impact
We have integrated research structure of sufficient scale to enable major engineering challenges to be tackled effectively. Discover the groundbreaking research undertaken by our staff and students.
Research impact
Research opportunities
Find out more about available PhD funding opportunities and our application procedure.
Postgraduate research opportunities
Centres for Doctoral Training
We host a number of Centres for Doctoral Training (CDTs) funded by the UKRI Research Councils:
Applied Quantum Technologies (CDT-AQT)
Diversity led, mission-driven research (DiveIn)
Exascale Computing for Earth, Environmental, and Sustainability Solutions (ExaGEO DLA)
Future Ultrasonic Engineering (FUSE)
lifeTIME (engineering underpinning medicine)
Photonic Integration and Advanced Data Storage (PIADS)
Robotics and AI for Net Zero (RAINZ)
Study
1st in Scotland Aeronautical & Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Electronics & Electrical Engineering (Complete University Guide 2025)
86.2% professional employment (Times ST Professional, Graduate Outcomes 2025)
Study engineering
Learn from world-renowned engineering experts and develop the technical skills and innovative thinking essential for solving real-world challenges. Our interdisciplinary programs also give you the flexibility to explore engineering alongside other fields of interest.
